title: ProviderCheck
description: The result of one read-only scan of one kind in one account. 'Nothing found' is only shown when a check succeeded; stale data is shown with its age.

provider.description: Provider slug from the adapter file, e.g. supabase or vercel. Not an enum: new adapters add providers without schema changes.

kind.description: Resource kind as <provider>.<kind>, e.g. supabase.table or vercel.deployment.

scope.description: Narrower scope when the kind is listed per parent, e.g. a project ref.

rule_id.description: Set when this check evaluated an exposure rule (e.g. rls_disabled). A resource of this kind in this scope is not_exposed only if this check succeeded and produced no exposed finding for it.
